data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Book > Map search, type origin and pick the airport, set flexible dates, Search, open the list of results), and it names origin as a parameter; it is slightly off because it frames the trip type and date mode as optional and adds a result-click step with no parameter for which destination or date to pick.
